description: Builds Simulink subsystems from LaTeX ODE/algebraic equations using integrator chains, gains, and summers.
call_signature: [c, m, cellEq, info] = odeBuilder(eqStr, mdl, 'Params', params, 'IC', ic, 'Logging', true, 'Arrange', true)

fields.description: Space-separated double-quoted LaTeX equations in first-order form. E.g., '"\dot{x} = v" "\dot{v} = -k*x"'. Accepts char, string array, or cell array of chars.
Struct mapping parameter names to numeric values. Field names = parameter symbols used in equations. Written to model InitFcn. E.g., struct('k',100,'m',1,'b',0.5)
Struct mapping state names to initial condition values (numeric). State names must match LHS of \dot{} terms. E.g., struct('x',0,'v',1)
External input signal names. Auto-detected from equations if omitted. Explicit list forces specific inport ordering.

name_value_pairs.name: Logging
name_value_pairs.description: Enable signal logging on integrator outputs

outputs.c: Computational graph struct (nodeListOfEq, nodeToBlock) — compatible with createHierarchy
outputs.m: Model mapping struct — compatible with createHierarchy
outputs.cellEq: Cell array of individual equation strings (parsed from eqStr)

examples.name: forced_spring_damper
examples.description: Linear spring-mass-damper with external force input

examples.name: induction_motor_dq
examples.description: 5-state induction motor in dq frame with algebraic outputs

spec.equations: "\dot{\psi_{ds}} = v_{ds} - R_s * i_{ds} + \omega_e * \psi_{qs}" "\dot{\psi_{qs}} = v_{qs} - R_s * i_{qs} - \omega_e * \psi_{ds}" "\dot{\psi_{dr}} = -R_r * i_{dr} + (\omega_e - \omega_r) * \psi_{qr}" "\dot{\psi_{qr}} = -R_r * i_{qr} - (\omega_e - \omega_r) * \psi_{dr}" "\dot{\omega_r} = (T_e - T_L - B * \omega_r) * P / (2*J)" "i_{ds} = (L_r * \psi_{ds} - L_m * \psi_{dr}) / (L_s * L_r - L_m^2)" "T_e = (3*P/4) * L_m * (i_{qs} * \psi_{dr} - i_{ds} * \psi_{qr}) / L_r"
